Do not equate the revised complementary contingency with STMT-NB-A1-CONTINGENTS-CAUSED, NecessaryAt, a material implication, or source-definition N-to-Box-N. Distinguish possibility of some classified individual from applying that SAME individual's revised condition at the designated world. Counterfactual interpretation, membership across worlds, actual bearer guards and rigid identity remain unselected/open. Existing source causal-prefix readings and source-agnostic ancestry/modal theorems do not settle this semantic choice.
